name: Micro Finance Loan (Demo Placeholder)
description: Placeholder micro-finance scheme data for small enterprises. Includes an advisory (non-critical) priority rule. DEMO DATA ONLY.

source.note: Placeholder micro-finance rule data. Not an official source.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant age must be between 18 and 60 years.
Annual family income must not exceed the rural/urban limit (rural INR 1,20,000, urban INR 1,60,000).
The micro-enterprise must have been operating for at least 1 year.
Advisory: priority is given to women-led and transgender-led enterprises. Not a disqualifier.

claims: Annual family income limit is INR 1,20,000 for rural applicants and INR 1,60,000 for urban applicants.
The micro finance loan interest rate is 12% per annum.
The maximum micro finance loan amount is INR 60,000.
